invariants.rationale: Since a return value is always constructed and returned by execute(), 'result' should not be null.
The method always passes preppedRecords to the executor, so it is expected to be non-null at this program point.
instantTime is directly used as a parameter to another method; null would likely lead to a NPE or logic error.
context is directly cast and used, so it is expected to be non-null at method exit.
